summary: Re-review of fix commit 5c437cfdb on top of 8f010425d: the fix still meets the spec and adds no new divergence. All 4 acceptance criteria still hold (AC4 per the caller's 928/928 report; no shell in this review).

per_ac.ac: AC1 waiting result: task not done, run not complete, deploy not scheduled
AC2 loop reports waiting with PR URL; resume re-dispatches the same task
AC3 second ok result moves on to deploy, or ends the run with deploy_target none
AC4 every current shipwright-run test stays green

notes_non_blocking: PR link regex requires a host; the stop-hook copy is identical; negative cases cover it.
hooks/master_stop_check.py _waiting_task does not check the new 'released' flag: between a confirmed resume and the next single-session-next the banner could still name the PR. Not a spec divergence.

ac_verdicts.reason: A contract-valid waiting result leaves the task in_progress and not failed, schedules no successor and leaves the run status unchanged; next answers waiting with the link and next step; a confirmed resume releases the hold so the same task is dispatched again; a later ok moves on to deploy or completes the run when deploy_target is none.
